grades.reason: Describes file descriptors and read/write semantics in xv6. It says nothing about network filesystems or where the kernel dispatches operations to a filesystem implementation.

grades.quote: When a process later opens a device file, the kernel diverts read and write system calls to the kernel device implementation instead of passing them to the file system.
grades.reason: Describes the xv6 file system. It has no network filesystem and no dispatch point for one. The only loosely related point is that opening a device file makes the kernel divert read/write to a device implementation instead of the file system. That is an analogy for dispatch, not an answer about network filesystems.
